List available models from the API

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.list_models().await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
}
```
